description: This Java class provides the default implementation of the HttpPushConfig interface, managing HTTP push configuration including maximum queue size and proxy settings.

classes.name: DefaultHttpPushConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HttpPushConfig, encapsulating HTTP push configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method for creating an instance of DefaultHttpPushConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum queue size for HTTP push.

methods.name: getHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns the HTTP proxy configuration associated with this push configuration.
